data.desc: Oragenics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing brain-targeted therapeutics through proprietary intranasal delivery technology. The Company's lead candidate, ONP-002, is being advanced as a potential first-in-class treatment for concussion and mild traumatic brain injury. Subject to its ability to raise additional capital, of which there can be no assurances, Oragenics hopes to continue progressing ONP-002 through Phase IIa clinical trials in Australia and to pursue U.S. Phase IIb trials in the future. During September 2026, the Company encountered device stability concerns that it is currently evaluating, which caused a pause in participant enrollment. As of the date hereof, this pause remains in effect. Furthermore, capital constraints are limiting the Company's ability to continue to pursue its ONP-002 clinical trials. The Company believes its intranasal delivery platform has potential applications across multiple neurological conditions.
